- `docs` contains clean, well-organized documentation.
- `lib` contains the source code that will be exposed by the library.
- `lib/math` contains the math function/class 
- `tests` contains the tests.
- `tests/feature` contains simple, reproducible examples showing features working.
- `tests/bugs` contains larger boards where no specific problem is the focus.
